#' Generates an Excel workbook containing information on all Analytical QC records that contain a given list of DTXSIDs
#'
#' @md
#' @description
#' `r lifecycle::badge("experimental")`
#' @param base_url base_url
#' @param ids ids
#' @param include_classyfire include_classyfire
#' @param include_functional_uses include_functional_uses
#' @param include_source_counts include_source_counts
#' @param methodologies methodologies
#' @return Raw Excel workbook bytes. Errors retain typed HTTP or transport conditions.
#' @apiStage public
#' @export
# Generated with specmill; do not edit by hand.
chemi_amos_analytical_qc_batch <- function(
  base_url = NULL,
  ids = NULL,
  include_classyfire = NULL,
  include_functional_uses = NULL,
  include_source_counts = NULL,
  methodologies = NULL
) {
  params <- base::list(
    "base_url" = base_url,
    "ids" = ids,
    "include_classyfire" = include_classyfire,
    "include_functional_uses" = include_functional_uses,
    "include_source_counts" = include_source_counts,
    "methodologies" = methodologies
  )
  result <- .ct_request(
    "method" = "POST",
    "path" = "/api/amos/analytical_qc_batch_search",
    "path_params" = structure(list(), names = character(0)),
    "query" = structure(list(), names = character(0)),
    "body" = base::local({
      body <- base::Filter(base::Negate(base::is.null), params)
      body$identifiers <- base::as.list(body$ids)
      body$ids <- NULL
      if (FALSE) {
        body$exclude_analytical_qc <- FALSE
      }
      body <- .api_validation$body_value(
        body,
        list(
          required = list(
            "base_url",
            "identifiers",
            "include_classyfire",
            "include_functional_uses",
            "include_source_counts",
            "methodologies"
          ),
          properties = list(
            base_url = list(
              description = "URL for the AMOS frontend.  Used to construct the internal links in the output file.",
              type = "string",
              minLength = 1L,
              example = "https://amos.example.org"
            ),
            include_classyfire = list(
              description = "Flag for whether to include the top four levels of a ClassyFire classification for each of the searched substances, if it exists.",
              type = "boolean"
            ),
            include_functional_uses = list(
              description = "Flag for whether to include functional use classifications based on the ChemFuncT ontology.  Only exists for around 21,000 substances in the database.",
              type = "boolean"
            ),
            include_source_counts = list(
              description = "Flag for whether to include counts of a substance's appearances in patents, PubMed articles, and other external sources.",
              type = "boolean"
            ),
            methodologies = list(
              additionalProperties = list(type = "boolean"),
              required = list(
                "all"
              ),
              properties = list(all = list(type = "boolean")),
              description = "Filters the returned results by analytical methodologies.  This argument should be a dictionary with four keys with boolean values -- \"all\", \"GC/MS\", \"LC/MS\", and \"NMR\".  There are some methodologies with small numbers of records (e.g., IR spectra) which will only appear in the data if \"all\" is set to true.",
              example = list(
                `GC/MS` = TRUE,
                `LC/MS` = TRUE,
                NMR = FALSE,
                all = FALSE
              ),
              type = "object"
            ),
            identifiers = list(
              minItems = 1L,
              description = "List of DTXSIDs or other identifiers to search for.",
              example = list("DTXSID9020112", "DTXSID3022401", "benzene"),
              items = list(type = "string"),
              type = "array"
            )
          ),
          type = "object",
          example = list(
            base_url = "https://amos.example.org",
            include_classyfire = FALSE,
            include_functional_uses = FALSE,
            include_source_counts = FALSE,
            methodologies = list(all = TRUE),
            identifiers = list("DTXSID9020112")
          )
        )
      )
      body$identifiers <- base::I(body$identifiers)
      body
    }),
    "headers" = list(Accept = "application/vnd.ms-excel"),
    "server" = list(url = "https://hcd.rtpnc.epa.gov"),
    "server_resolver" = list(
      name = ".ct_server_url",
      key = "chemi_burl",
      relative = "/"
    ),
    "auth" = list(),
    "request_controls" = list(preserve_errors = TRUE)
  )
  result
}
